description: The AI guide will assist you in performing the simulation accurately at each step.
note: The Star Load is selected by default. If a wire is connected incorrectly, click the corresponding label number to remove the connection.
observe: The Star-connected lamps glow less brightly because each phase receives VL/√3, whereas the Delta-connected lamps glow brighter because each phase receives the full line voltage (VL).

steps.title: STEP 1
steps.content: Make connections as per the instructions given below or you can click the **AUTOCONNECT** button to make the connections automatically.

steps.title: STEP 2
steps.content: For manual connections, click the **CHECK** button to verify the connections. Autoconnect will automatically verify the connections.

steps.title: STEP 3
steps.content: Switch ON the MCB by clicking the MCB lever.

steps.title: STEP 4
steps.content: Click the **ADD** button to record the readings.

steps.title: STEP 5
steps.content: Switch OFF the MCB and select the other load configuration. To convert Star to Delta, keep all supply and meter connections, remove the lamp connections (17–19) and (19–21), then make (16–19), (18–21), (17–20). For Delta to Star, reverse these lamp connections.

steps.title: STEP 6
steps.content: Repeat the steps 2 to 4 to add the readings for the next load.

steps.title: STEP 7
steps.content: Select Star or Delta from the dropdown, enter the required values from the observation table and enter calculated power and click the **Calculate** button.

steps.title: STEP 8
steps.content: In Error Analysis, enter the measured and true values and click the **Calculate Error** button to calculate the percentage error.

steps.title: STEP 9
steps.content: Select a different load from the dropdown and repeat the steps 7 to 8.

steps.title: STEP 10
steps.content: Click the **GENERATE REPORT** button to generate the simulation report.

steps.title: STEP 11
steps.content: Click the **PRINT** button to print the simulation or simulation report.

steps.title: STEP 12
steps.content: Click the **RESET** button to restart the simulation.

welcome.text: Hello! I am your AI Guide. I will guide you through each step of the experiment. Please follow the instructions carefully and perform the actions as directed. Before we begin, let us familiarize ourselves with the simulation interface. To start, click on the start walkthrough.

walkthroughComplete.text: The interface walkthrough is now complete. You are now ready to perform the experiment. You may either click the Auto Connect button to make the circuit connections automatically or connect the circuit manually by following the highlighted terminals. Let's begin with the first connection.
